OptimizerConvergence.Compatible.definition: fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] g d s => inner ℝ g d ≤ inner ℝ g s ∧ ‖d‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖s‖ ^ 2
OptimizerConvergence.Compatible.type: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] → E → E → E → Prop

OptimizerConvergence.Contraction.definition: fun L η μ m => min (η * m) ((1 - η * L - μ ^ 2) / (1 - η * L))

OptimizerConvergence.Energy.definition: fun {E} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] {ι} [inst_1 : Fintype ι] f star L η x u =>   @OptimizerConvergence.Gap E ι inst_1 f star x + (1 - η * L) / (2 * η) * @OptimizerConvergence.SqMass E inst ι inst_1 u
OptimizerConvergence.Energy.type: {E : Type u_1} → [NormedAddCommGroup E] → {ι : Type u_2} → [Fintype ι] → (E → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → (ι → E) → (ι → E) → ℝ

OptimizerConvergence.Gap.definition: fun {E} {ι} [Fintype ι] f star x => ∑ i, (f (x i) - star)
OptimizerConvergence.Gap.type: {E : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → [Fintype ι] → (E → ℝ) → ℝ → (ι → E) → ℝ

OptimizerConvergence.GradDominance.definition: fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] f g star m => ∀ (x : E), 2 * m * (f x - star) ≤ ‖g x‖ ^ 2
OptimizerConvergence.GradDominance.type: {E : Type u_1} → [NormedAddCommGroup E] → (E → ℝ) → (E → E) → ℝ → ℝ → Prop

OptimizerConvergence.Guard.definition: fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] L η G d =>   inner ℝ G d + L / 2 * ‖d‖ ^ 2 ≤ -(η / 2) * ‖G‖ ^ 2 ∧ ‖d‖ ≤ 2 * η * ‖G‖
OptimizerConvergence.Guard.type: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] → ℝ → ℝ → E → E → Prop

OptimizerConvergence.GuardedStep.definition: fun {E} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] L η G candidate =>   if @OptimizerConvergence.Guard E inst inst_1 L η G candidate then candidate else -η • G
OptimizerConvergence.GuardedStep.type: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] → ℝ → ℝ → E → E → E

OptimizerConvergence.Mean.definition: fun {Ω} [Fintype Ω] prob value => ∑ w, prob w * value w
OptimizerConvergence.Mean.type: {Ω : Type u_3} → [Fintype Ω] → (Ω → ℝ) → (Ω → ℝ) → ℝ

OptimizerConvergence.SqMass.definition: fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {ι} [Fintype ι] v => ∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2

OptimizerConvergence.Trial.definition: fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] μ η a u g ξ => (μ * a) • u - η • (g + ξ)
